name: Espresso
description: A single shot pulled short and dense, with a thick crema and a bittersweet, nutty finish. Nothing added.

name: Cold Brew
description: Coarse-ground beans steeped in cold water for 18 hours. Smooth and very low in acidity, served black over ice.

name: Cappuccino
description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk and a deep cap of foam. Balanced and comforting rather than sweet.

name: Oat Milk Flat White
description: A double shot under thin, glossy oat milk microfoam. Silky and lightly cereal-sweet with no added sugar.

name: Iced Vanilla Latte
description: Espresso, cold milk and vanilla syrup over ice. Our most popular sweet drink and an easy first coffee.

name: Hazelnut Mocha
description: Dark chocolate ganache and toasted hazelnut syrup stirred into espresso and steamed milk, finished with whipped cream.

name: Decaf Soy Caramel Macchiato
description: Swiss-water decaf espresso layered over sweetened soy milk and finished with a vegan salted caramel drizzle. All the ritual, none of the buzz, and no dairy.

name: Affogato
description: A scoop of vanilla bean gelato drowned in a fresh double shot. Half drink, half dessert, best eaten with a spoon.
